data.name: Shishu
data.gender_notes: Shishu is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shishu is recorded with the meaning “Little One”. Shishu is a Hindu name meaning “Little One”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shishu expresses “Little One”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: शिशु
in_sanskrit.meaning: लॐटी शिशु, लौटावला, संतुलित शिशु, बालक
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is new, tender, little, and just born, the infant, the child

in_hindi.name: शिशु
in_hindi.long_meaning: A child, an infant, a little one, a tender one

in_tamil.name: சிஷு
in_tamil.meaning: அழகியவர், அல்லவல், அடிக்கட் வரவும், அடிக்கட் இல்லையார்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who is new, tender, just born, or not yet arrived

in_telugu.name: శిషు
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is tender, the little one, the infant, the god of infants, the goddess of infants

in_marathi.name: Shishu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shishu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is small, a little one, a beginner, a novice, a scholar, or a sage

in_bengali.name: Shishu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Little One
in_bengali.long_meaning: Shishu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is small, a little one, a beginner, a novice, a scholar, or a sage
